item.tib: dpon gsas dran pa nam mkha'i bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang gi sgrub pa
item.coloph: stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis gtan la phabs pa'o/ 'di la bka' gter rnam pa gnyis yod de/ gter ni byang phyogs gsang ba'i brag la sbas// bka' ni 'od ldan 'bar ma stang 'dzin yin/ rjes 'breng skal ldan gshen (blo ldan snying po (mchan))la snyan du brgyud/ bon rnams btang bzhag tshad la mkhas par mdzod/ ces gdams pa'o/ dpon gsas bla ma'i sgrub pa 'di ni 'gro ba'i don du rgya cher 'phel bar shog/
